title: Assistant answers time out at peak while the model looks slow
scenario: At Kestrel's evening peak more than 10 percent of assistant answers hit the gateway's 30 s timeout. The model spans are the longest in the trace, so the team wants to fail over to the other provider. A tool change shipped the same morning. Read the traces and find the real cause.
task: Read both traces; count and time the catalog spans under check_inventory
Explain why short questions work, why only at peak, and whether a provider switch helps
Fix the tool: batch endpoint, concurrency cap, deadline from the request budget, partial results
Prove it with make demo and tests; write ANSWER.md
acceptance: 40 lookups complete in one batch call well under the budget
At most 4 catalog calls in flight; batches of at most 50
Deadline returns partial results flagged stock_unknown instead of failing
Root cause named with trace evidence; red herring ruled out

practices.label: Week 5 - resilience patterns: timeouts, bulkheads, deadlines
Week 3 - tool calls in the agent loop
